the_tie_unit_DEFINED: a PER-JUDGE PAIR CELL tie: judge J's cell on pair P is a tie iff J's two order-passes (det, mir) yield different arm-votes, or J's only served pass voted TIE. The unit is the (judge, pair) cell — NOT the panel-level pair (my R132 '6' was the panel-majority unit, and even that was miscounted: the true panel-level count is 3, and the per-judge count the auditor used is 16). The CANONICAL unit going forward = the per-judge pair cell (the auditor's unit; it is the one that governs qualification arithmetic: a judge's ties are that judge's instability).
